inputs.statement:
LOAD SaleID, Customer, SaleDate,
     Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00') AS Amount,
     SubField(Path, '/', 3) AS Country,
     KeepChar(Code, '0123456789') AS CodeDigits,
     Round(Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00'), 10) AS AmountRounded,
     Class(Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00'), 500) AS AmountBand

output.notes: Num# parsing implemented by removing thousand separator ',' and casting to DOUBLE; SubField using SPLIT_PART; KeepChar via REGEXP_REPLACE; Round to nearest multiple of 10 using ROUND(x/10)*10; Class emulated with FLOOR and string concatenation.
output.sql: SELECT "src"."SaleID" AS "SaleID", "src"."Customer" AS "Customer", "src"."SaleDate" AS "SaleDate", CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText", ',', '') AS DOUBLE) AS "Amount", SPLIT_PART("src"."Path", '/', 3) AS "Country", REGEXP_REPLACE("src"."Code", '[^0-9]', '') AS "CodeDigits", (ROUND(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText", ',', '') AS DOUBLE) / 10) * 10) AS "AmountRounded", CONCAT(CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText", ',', '') AS DOUBLE) / 500) * 500 AS VARCHAR), ' <= x < ', CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText", ',', '') AS DOUBLE) / 500) * 500 + 500 AS VARCHAR)) AS "AmountBand" FROM "src"
